blockers: descriptor architectury: Architectury generation requires an evidenced intersection for every selected target loader.
descriptor forge: Forge tuples remain discovered until later compilation and artifact inspection gates pass.
descriptor multiloader: A multiloader target is selectable only when every selected loader intersection is explicitly evidenced.
descriptor neoforge: NeoForge toolchain boundaries remain discovered until later compilation and artifact inspection gates pass.
profile architectury-multiloader: Architectury targets must prove a common Minecraft, mappings, Fabric, Forge, or NeoForge intersection before generation.
profile forge-legacy: ForgeGradle, mappings, wrapper, and JDK boundaries still require tuple specific build evidence.
profile forge-modern: Modern ForgeGradle and metadata boundaries need tuple specific build evidence.
profile neoforge-modern: NeoGradle and ModDevGradle require separate, tuple specific verification before selection is enabled.
